data.narrative: The student chose refine-first and kept a service-layer pub/sub activity feed instead of Postgres NOTIFY. Scores held at structural 4 while surface rose from 3 to 4. BREAK showed a Round-3 spiral: the writer closed after the first WebSocket event. FIX removed that close without restarting the bus; two events then delivered and VERIFY handshake/replay/cleanup still passed.

dimension_scores.observation: FIX prompt named the writer loop, forbade changing publish/subscribe/replay, and defined success as two events without a close.
dimension_scores.evidence: progress/ai-augmented-module5-fix.md: stop closing after first send_json; do not change publish, subscribe, or replay_since.

dimension_scores.observation: Logged structural vs surface each round and measured the silent drop with a two-publish ASGI probe.
dimension_scores.evidence: BREAK_FIRST_EVENT_OK True; BREAK_SECOND_EVENT_MISSING True; BREAK_SILENT_CLOSE True.

dimension_scores.observation: Four iterations, zero restarts. Did not throw away a structural-4 bus to chase a one-line close.
dimension_scores.evidence: Log R1 4/3, R2-4 4/4; FIX_EVENT_CREATED_COUNT 2 after deleting DROP_AFTER_FIRST_EVENT only.

dimension_scores.observation: Rejected NOTIFY because localhost:5432 is down; treated the drop as surface on a sound Queue writer.
dimension_scores.evidence: ITER_STRUCTURAL_NOT_NOTIFY True; DECIDE A refine-first with a two-event safety rail.

dimension_scores.observation: Shipped /ws/teams/{id}/activity with membership, replay, ping/pong, and invitation events without emails in payloads.
dimension_scores.evidence: VERIFY_WS_ACCEPT True; VERIFY_RECONNECT_GOT_MISSED True; ITER_NO_EMAIL_IN_PAYLOAD True; FIX_BOTH_EVENTS True.

strengths: Kept the architecture when the bug was a writer close, not a wrong transport.
Proved reconnect replay and subscriber cleanup over raw ASGI without adding httpx.
data.recommendation: Add the two-event WebSocket probe next to module09 so a future heartbeat change cannot ship a silent drop.
